meta.expNote: v62 base EXP. Old School Maple's library multiplies this by 1.5 (Cerebes 295 -> 442).
meta.scrollPriceSource: MapleStory Classic free-market sales on maplefm.gg, updated November 1, 2026. Not Old School Maple.
meta.scrollMatch: Prices joined by equipment slot, stat, and success rate because MapleStory Classic item ids do not match v62.
meta.dropLists: Old School Maple library pages at https://www.oldschoolmaplegame.com/mob/{id}, scraped 2026-11-02. The library publishes items, not chances.
meta.dropRates: Equal average of Cosmic v83, HeavenMS v83, StreetMS, and the 2019 OSM monster_drops table for each monster-item pair those sources list. Omitted pairs are not zeros. OSM 2019 chances are divided by 1,000,000,000. The other three use 1,000,000. Library items with no rate stay at chance 0 and are not counted as mesos.
